_comment: Cross-step plan for run.py. Every kanban argv is appended to BV2_KANBAN_CMD (default 'hermes kanban').
set_boomerang_wake: the card level is set with `kanban edit <id> --boomerang-wake` (t_7be18632).
If the live run aborts at set_boomerang_wake, fix the argv here, not run.py.
inject_failure: the AC-7 live fault (t_480d08ce), run AFTER the failure card's child is dispatched. A comment by
another session moves the card past the claim cursor, so the verdict executor refuses it ('state moved', _moved)
and run_entry -> _fail posts the warning AND re-surfaces the wake into the still-live home. null = SKIP (live).
Never rehome the card (edit --session <bogus>): that proves only the warning half ('no live home').
s1_fault_hold (optional): a --body that keeps the failure card's child busy so the fault lands first.
wirelog_sync: run after the step-3 canary when a remote seat served it ({sub} = the bare seat number).
expect.*: the restart line is today's real boot line; the step-4 regexes are the reconciler's own INFO lines
expects the redispatch (t_870c1fba); arm 2 pre-spends the card's retry (BV2_WAKE_STATE) and expects the re-surface.

board_create: Boomerang v2 smoke harness scratch board (t_989cde1b); safe to archive
block_needs_input: bv2 smoke: forced needs_input event. unblock_when: after:+1d
inject_failure: bv2 smoke s1 fault: board write after the boomerang-wake claim; the verdict must be refused (state moved) and the wake re-surfaced

expect.resurface_log_regex: kanban boomerang-wake: {card} lost reason=gateway restart, retry spent resurfaced delivered=(?P<delivered>\w+)
expect.redispatch_log_regex: kanban boomerang-wake: {card} redispatched after gateway restart \(retry \d+/\d+\) delegation=(?P<delegation>\S+)
